raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Add `MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION` constant and `handshake_version`/`mode` fields to `MoRIIOAgentMetadata` so mismatched peers are rejected during the ZMQ handshake
- `_validate_handshake_compat()` in `MoRIIOConnectorWorker` checks:
  - Version mismatch (hard reject via `HandshakeError`)
  - Same-mode peers, e.g. both READ or both WRITE (soft warning)
  - Block length mismatch (hard reject)
  - Attention backend mismatch (soft warning)
- Legacy peers (version=0 / missing fields) accepted with warning for rolling upgrades
- Unit tests for field defaults, msgspec round-trip, and legacy peer decode

Related: ROCm/mori#759

## Test plan

- [ ] `test_moriio_handshake_compat.py`: field defaults, msgspec round-trip, legacy peer decode, constant verification
- [ ] Existing `test_moriio_connector.py` still passes (new fields use defaults)

  - Block length mismatch (hard reject)

- Legacy peers (version=0 / missing fields) accepted with warning for rolling upgrades
- Unit tests for field defaults, msgspec round-trip, and legacy peer decode

Related: ROCm/mori#759

+"""Tests for MoRIIO handshake compatibility checks (Gap 12)."""
+import msgspec

+)
+
+
+class TestMoRIIOAgentMetadataCompat:
+    """Verify that the new compatibility fields exist and serialize correctly."""
+
+    def test_handshake_version_default(self):
+        meta = MoRIIOAgentMetadata(
+            engine_id="e1",
+            agent_metadata=b"",
+            kv_caches_base_addr=[0],
+            num_blocks=1,
+            block_len=128,
+            attn_backend_name="flash_attn",
+        )
+        assert meta.handshake_version == MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION
+        assert MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION >= 1
+
+    def test_mode_field_default(self):
+        meta = MoRIIOAgentMetadata(
+            engine_id="e1",
+            agent_metadata=b"",
+            kv_caches_base_addr=[0],
+            num_blocks=1,
+            block_len=128,
+            attn_backend_name="flash_attn",
+        )
+        assert meta.mode == ""
+
+    def test_mode_field_set(self):
+        meta = MoRIIOAgentMetadata(
+            engine_id="e1",
+            agent_metadata=b"",
+            kv_caches_base_addr=[0],
+            num_blocks=1,
+            block_len=128,
+            attn_backend_name="flash_attn",
+            mode=MoRIIOMode.WRITE.value,
+        )
+        assert meta.mode == "write"
+
+    def test_msgspec_roundtrip_preserves_new_fields(self):
+        orig = MoRIIOAgentMetadata(
+            engine_id="e1",
+            agent_metadata=b"\x01\x02",
+            kv_caches_base_addr=[100, 200],
+            num_blocks=10,
+            block_len=256,
+            attn_backend_name="flash_attn",
+            handshake_version=MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION,
+            mode="write",
+        )
+        encoder = msgspec.msgpack.Encoder()
+        decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(MoRIIOAgentMetadata)
+        data = encoder.encode(orig)
+        decoded = decoder.decode(data)
+
+        assert decoded.handshake_version == MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION
+        assert decoded.mode == "write"
+        assert decoded.engine_id == "e1"
+        assert decoded.block_len == 256
+
+    def test_legacy_peer_missing_new_fields(self):
+        """A legacy peer that omits handshake_version/mode should decode
+        with defaults (0 and "" respectively) thanks to omit_defaults."""
+        legacy_data = {
+            "engine_id": "legacy",
+            "agent_metadata": b"",
+            "kv_caches_base_addr": [0],
+            "num_blocks": 1,
+            "block_len": 128,
+            "attn_backend_name": "flash_attn",
+        }
+        encoder = msgspec.msgpack.Encoder()
+        raw = encoder.encode(legacy_data)
+        decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(MoRIIOAgentMetadata)
+        meta = decoder.decode(raw)
+
+        assert meta.handshake_version == MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION
+        assert meta.mode == ""
+
+    def test_handshake_version_constant(self):
+        assert isinstance(MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION, int)
+        assert MORIIO_HANDSHAKE_VERSION >= 1
